name: Heliotrope Vigil

detectability.signature: A heliotrope shimmer enclosing motionless shapes; internal clocks read exactly zero delta across every observation.

proximity: Chronometers desynchronize within a degree of the boundary
Watch hands and process timers visibly stutter at the interface
contact: Touching the surface halts sensation in the contacting limb, held mid-gesture
Probes inserted return having experienced no elapsed time whatsoever
prolonged_exposure: Anything fully enclosed remains frozen indefinitely until the field releases it
Rescuers working the boundary for weeks develop temporal disorientation and dream in stopped moments

phenomena: Visible echoes of the moment the field formed, replaying on its skin
Objects existing in multiple timeframes simultaneously along the boundary gradient
Radio signals reflecting perfectly, undegraded, off the stasis surface
hazards: Trapped in time loop at the boundary gradient
Desynchronization from normal spacetime after extended interface work
opportunities: Preservation of perishable cargo and wounded patients indefinitely
Recovery of lost ships and personnel when the field eventually releases
Archaeological significance as a perfectly preserved moment of the Old War
known_incidents: The salvage tug Meridian Bell was found in 2299 frozen mid-broadcast beside the dome, her mayday still queued on the field's skin; all nine crew stand at their posts, alive by every measure except time.
A ransom syndicate attempted to weaponize a portable stasis shard in 2304 and succeeded only in preserving their own getaway vehicle, with themselves inside, for six years.
description: Heliotrope Vigil is a perfect dome of paused light, violet-pink as dusk wine, twelve kilometers across and utterly silent. Within it a battle scene stands mid-motion: three warships of a design two centuries dead, their hull breaches arrested in blossoming petals of frost and fire. Every scan returns the same impossible reading — zero change, forever.

The field does not flicker, breathe, or age; instruments placed against its skin record no elapsed time at all. Objects pushed partway in halt mid-gesture, sensation suspended in the contacted limb. Engineers have mapped the boundary to the millimeter and can explain none of it.

The Old War's final dispatches mention an experimental vigil engine deployed near this system, which would date the dome at roughly 212 years. In 2299 salvagers found the tug Meridian Bell frozen alongside it, mayday still queued on the surface, her crew alive by every measure except duration. Courts still dispute whether rescuing them means waking them or killing them.

The Vigil has become a pilgrimage site for historians, hospice orders, and one very patient insurance syndicate. Some believe the field is failing, citing hairline iridescence along its southern face; others believe it is waiting for something to arrive. Visitors are asked to leave no clocks at the boundary, as they will be wrong when retrieved.
